Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Measures].[Forms] AS SetToStr({OpeningPeriod(), ClosingPeriod([Time].[Month], [Time].[1997]), OpeningPeriod([Time].[Year], [Time].[1997].[Q2]), ClosingPeriod([Time].[Quarter], [Time].[1997].[Q2]), ClosingPeriod([Time].[1997])}) MEMBER [Measures].[Weekly] AS ClosingPeriod([Time.Weekly].[Week], [Time].[1997]).UniqueName SELECT {[Measures].[Forms], [Measures].[Weekly]} ON 0 FROM [ZFMSALES] WHERE [Time].[1997].[Q3]
